newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENCOR SEES BILLITON LISTING IN AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: GENCOR SEES BILLITON LISTING IN AUGUST.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its new base metals company Billiton Plc to raise over $1 billion through a global equity placement in July, with the shares commencing trading in London in August.
"Billiton will...seek to raise in excess of $1 billion via an equity placement during July in the international capital markets," chairman Brian Gilbertson told a news conference.
"The committee of the London Stock Exchange has agreed that Billiton will have its primary listing on the LSE and trading should commence there during August 1997."
Gilbertson said he expected strong international demand for Billiton equity.
"Because of the world-class nature of its mining assets, we anticipate that there will be strong international demand for Billiton equity," he said.
The new capital and Billiton's low gearing would enable it to act decisively in seizing investment opportunities.
